items.title: 67259_Big Chief Moore oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I went to school with a fellow there, Sonny Chorie and he was a wrestler. He went by the name of Sonny Warcloud.

ctx.x: I see, it was far away from home to find another like member of the group. It was really good.
I went to school with a fellow there, Sonny Chorie and he was a wrestler. He went by the name of Sonny Warcloud.
